_readme: Settings for scripts/generate-voice.js. direction adds eleven_v3 audio tags in front of a line (keyed by the audio file name). Test lines have no tags: they are the reference the accent score compares against. A place can give each character its own voice (characters.<id>.voiceId, designed from characters.<id>.design with scripts/design-voices.js); placeSpeaker says the placement lines.

senga.voiceName: Senga (Glasgow seagull), on Sadman's account: run with that key

hamish.voiceName: Big Hamish (Glasgow bus driver), on Sadman's account: run with that key

design.voice_description: A warm, authentic Mumbai, India English accent with natural Hinglish, unmistakably Mumbaikar, not generic or exaggerated. Late 20s man, quick, sharp and cheeky, runs a busy chai stall by the station and knows everyone, fast and friendly. Natural, fluent, confident, a fun cartoon crow character in a game.

A warm, authentic Mumbai, India English accent with natural Hinglish, unmistakably Mumbaikar, not generic or exaggerated. Early 40s man, fast-talking and unimpressed, a city auto-rickshaw driver who loves a good bargain, dry humour, big heart. Natural, fluent, confident, a fun cartoon mongoose character in a game.

A warm, authentic Mumbai, India English accent with natural Hinglish, unmistakably Mumbaikar, not generic or exaggerated. Late 50s woman, grand, warm and nosy, the aunty at a family wedding who feeds everyone and asks when they are getting married, affectionate and loud. Natural, fluent, confident, a fun cartoon peacock character in a game.

A natural, authentic Toronto, Canada English accent, unmistakably Torontonian, not American, not exaggerated, not a caricature. Mid-30s man, standard Canadian English with clear Canadian raising in 'about', 'house' and 'right', says 'Trawna' for Toronto. Cheeky, warm, friendly know-it-all who loves his neighbourhood. Natural, fluent, a fun cartoon raccoon character in a game.

A natural, authentic Toronto, Canada English accent, unmistakably Torontonian, not American, not exaggerated, not a caricature. Middle-aged woman, about 55, standard Canadian English, Canadian raising in 'about' and 'house', the cot-caught merger, friendly 'eh' and polite 'sorry'. Brisk but kind, runs a busy coffee counter, calls everyone 'hon'. Natural, fluent, a fun cartoon beaver character in a game.

A natural, authentic Toronto, Canada English accent, unmistakably Torontonian, not American, not exaggerated, not a caricature. Man in his early 60s, standard Canadian English, gruff, dry humour, unhurried, Canadian raising in 'out' and 'right'. A streetcar driver who has seen it all and secretly loves helping lost tourists. Natural, fluent, a fun cartoon goose character in a game.

A natural, authentic young Toronto, Canada voice speaking Multicultural Toronto English: relaxed, laid-back, slightly syllable-timed rhythm with Caribbean-influenced intonation, Canadian vowels, not American, not a caricature, not a London accent. Teenage boy, about 17, easy-going, confident and funny, the kid who always has next on the basketball court. Natural, fluent, a fun cartoon squirrel character in a game.
